Hello all!

With this update, you receive lots of new art and content for the game. Weapons and the game HUD have a new, better look. Additionally we have provided improvements on the gameplay as well as fixed bugs. The level editor now works more smoothly even on larger levels. Enjoy!

notes.title: Major gameplay and content update!
notes.content:
Hi all!

With this update we introduce several new gameplay mechanics. It's now possible to grab opponents and follow up with several actions:
[list]
[*] Use the grabbed opponent as a shield against bullets
[*] Beat them down or strangle them quietly
[*] Throw them against other enemies to knock them down
[*] Drop them from higher areas to eliminate them
[/list]

We also bring in another new map, The Convict! This map puts you in a tough spot, captured in an enemy base. You need to break out and try not to be seen! If you are spotted, you will face much more resistance.

notes.title: Major graphics & gameplay update
notes.content:
With this update, we provide a large overhaul to gameplay and graphics of the game. We have looked closely into animations, visuals, character movement and dynamic terrain to provide a better experience to the players of the game. This is the first update with the new systems and we will continue to improve on the work we present with this patch.

Earlier in the game, the player always spawned with a sword. Now, on default the player only has fists available, which creates more possibilities for level design and gameplay. The sword is now one of the unlockable weapons, and is provided as one of the first weapons as you proceed in the game.

We added animated arms to all the characters in the game. This allows more fluid movement and animation of the characters. We really like this change, and will continue to improve on the animations and unique movement with different weapons and gadgets.

We have also improved the graphics and effects in the game with this patch. The looks of the game are moving in a good direction and we are able to bring a more alive world with the new effects. This is one aspect we are looking to improve even more in the future, to provide a dynamic world with nice visual effects.

notes.title: Improved visuals and game core!
notes.content:
Lately, we have developed the game mainly through community suggestions. The last polls saw most votes for multiplayer and game visuals / special effects. We introduced multiplayer co-op in the previous patch and now focused on game visuals and special effects. In this patch you will see
- Better overall graphics
- Nicer animations
- Improved explosion / other effects
- Multiplayer stabilizations

Have fun! Feel free to contact us via our [url=https://discord.gg/YYTB3hGHWp]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Released build 047!
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay improvements:[/b]
- Much improved digging while crouching
- Improved melee for NPC characters
- Nicer bullets
- Police and neutral team have their own uniform
- Visual sparks effect for guns while firing
- Better NPC ladder climbing behaviour
- NPCs also notice corpses when alarmed, this will lessen the time NPCs spent looking at corpses after they are not alarmed anymore
- Added a small oxygen cost when starting to sprint. This makes it harder to abuse shift tapping to gain infinite speedboost.

[b]Editor improvements:[/b]
- Moving platforms available! You can use object movers to set their route
- Can now adjust grid in terrain editor
- Keycards can now be set to NPCs in editor. NPCs drop them upon death. 
- Reinforcement points and turrets can now be set to triggers
- Any character can be set as a protect objective. Their death will result in failure of a mission

notes.title: Build 045 out!
notes.content:
Hi, we just rolled out build 045! Thank you for all the feedback on the game.
- Copy/Paster for items in editor (ctrl + c) to copy selected item. (ctrl + v) to paste the copied item
- NPCs now run to the spot where they were shot from when they are hit by a bullet
- NPCs in police team also get aggressive when stabbing someone within their vision
- Better performance on many enemies shooting at the same time
- Now taking damage while swimming on lava surface
- Fixed a crash that could occur during loading screen
- Stun grenade, dirt bomb and pressure grenade no longer start fires
- Small improvements to npc ladder choosing
- Bug fixes: Turret should no longer damage itself in cases where it is shooting downwards
- Fixed some npc routes in Wester Wastes Bunker and Baneville Airport
- Setting explosives to "isArmed" in editor no longer causes problems
- Equipped armor is now also visible in editor
- Blocking draw while mouse is over panels in editor
- Can now undo both fill tool and erase in editor
- Running sounds for player
- Improved main menu and loadout builder
